events.verdict: Green (HOU) places his off-arm against Davis (LAL) and releases from contact.
Brooks (HOU) and Davis (LAL) briefly get their arms tangled as they engage for position in the lane.
Finney-Smith (LAL) firms up in a screening position in Thompson's (HOU) path and the contact is marginal.
James (LAL) maintains his hand on the side of the ball in between dribbles.
Davis (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during Sengun's (HOU) drive to the basket. He briefly places an arm around his back, but quickly removes it during his shooting motion.
James (LAL) delivers contact to Thompson (HOU) that dislodges him from his legally obtained defensive position.
Reaves (LAL) commits a take foul on VanVleet (HOU).
Davis (LAL) commits a take foul on Sengun (HOU).

VanVleet (HOU) cleanly steals the pass away from James (LAL) and any ensuing contact is incidental. James signals for a timeout while the pass is in the air and the Lakers are not in possession of the ball and therefore, the timeout request is not granted.
James (LAL) extends his arms and initiates contact with VanVleet (HOU) that affects his SQBR during the drive.
Davis (LAL) extends his arms into Holiday (HOU) and illegally moves him away from his legally obtained position as the screen is set.
